title: KISS Group Photo Tour Edition Trading Cards New In Box 33 Card Set + Poster FUN
categoryName: Collectibles:Non-Sport Trading Cards:Sealed Trading Card Boxes
descriptionText: This is a rare and collectible KISS Group Photo Tour Edition Trading Cards set, featuring 33 cards and a poster. The set includes cards with images of the band members, including Gene, Box, and Peter, as well as other unique cards from the Tour Edition set. The cards are made of high-quality card stock and were manufactured by Press Pass in 2009. This set is perfect for fans of the KISS franchise and collectors of non-sport trading cards.
